core_requests: links.render / pivot_links_for: honour a public-value filter (pack- or link-level x_public_only, set on every core link of ip_network): no link for private, CGNAT, loopback, link-local, ULA, multicast, documentation or reserved addresses, overlapping CIDRs, private/reserved ASNs, single-label or internal names (P057 cond 9). The engine skips noise entities, but CGNAT (100.64/10) and any value typed into `v3lum links` still render core pack links.

Pivot pack schema: optional per-link max_tlp honoured by the renderers and listed by `v3lum links` with the warning (P057 cond 1/10, P170 cond 1/10, P083 cond 11); this batch reads x_max_tlp in pivot_gated_links for module links only, so those links are never listed by `v3lum links`.

Core placeholders {b64q} (links.b64 over an entry-declared vetted expression such as ip="{q}", P057 cond 11), {cidrp} (CIDR with a literal '/' before the prefix length: bgp.he.net answers 404 to %2F) and {urlhp} (URL host[:port]+path without scheme/query/fragment) so FOFA, the bgp.he.net prefix page and the CyberCrime-Tracker URL search can become core links (today module links via v3lum/modules/utility/pivot_gated_links.py).

ModuleResult.link(label, url, *, host, category, touches_target, verified, badge) or engine propagation of RenderedLink metadata for module links into case.links, so the renderers defang scan-trigger module links (ScamAdviser, securityheaders.com, URLVoid) at TLP:CLEAR/GREEN and hide them for entities found hostile later in the scan (P083 cond 11, P170 cond 9). Today module links reach case.links as plain {label, url}.

links.py {asn_num} encoder returns value[2:] unencoded: an Entity(ASN, value) built without normalisation can inject query parameters (found by this batch's hostile-value CI test; this batch's templates use {q}). Encode it with quote(safe='').

`v3lum links`: order inside a category by pack file order (the curated analyst-value order of cond 6) instead of by label, and optionally group by the entries' x_group (dns, whois, mail, routing, technology...).

`v3lum doctor --links` (cond 7): wire pivot_gated_links.recheck_report(today) (unverified links, links not re-checked for more than 180 days, future dates, pending entries) for the packs of this batch.
